 🔴ପ୍ରବଳ ବର୍ଷା ଆଲର୍ଟ Odisha Rain Alert Today | IMD Issues Heavy Rain Warning | Cyclone Update
 Odisha Rain Alert Today: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued rainfall warnings for several districts of Odisha on November 20, 2026, as Cyclone Akvan affects weather conditions across the state.
 Heavy to very heavy rainfall is expected at a few places, with isolated extremely heavy rainfall possible. Coastal and interior districts could experience intense rain, strong winds and thunderstorms.
 IMD has also highlighted flash flood risks in districts including Puri, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapara, Balasore, Bhadrak, Cuttack, Dhenkanal, Mayurbhanj, Keonjhar and Jajpur.
